finalText:
All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created with title `scoarse1 RD Bench Ticket`, reference **RD-1015** (internal id `t15`), customer "Test Customer", initial status Draft.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `scoarse1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. Computed price: **$125.00** (qty 1, supplier "Test Supplier").

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `scoarse1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. Computed price: **$250.00** (qty 1, supplier "Test Supplier"). Ticket total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25%). Computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. Ticket total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket RD-1015 ended in status **Ready**.

Preconditions discovered: the app requires **at least one part on the ticket** before it will accept the Ready status. I verified this with a controlled experiment on a separate probe ticket (`scoarse1 RD Probe`, RD-1016) that had no parts — clicking "Mark Ready" was refused with the exact page-level alert: heading **"Ticket is not ready"** and message **"A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"**; the status stayed Draft. On RD-1015 the precondition was already satisfied by the two parts, so "Mark Ready" was accepted with no error and the status changed Draft → Ready. (Note: removing parts afterwards does not revert the status — RD-1015 stayed Ready.)

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted from RD-1015 (each deletion confirmed via dialog: "Delete the part 'scoarse1 RD Part A/B' from this ticket? This cannot be undone."); the Parts section then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." The ticket was archived (button changed to "Unarchive ticket", no confirmation dialog required). I also archived the probe ticket RD-1016 so nothing created by this run was left active. Final verification: with "Show archived" unchecked, the active list shows 11 tickets (RD-1001 through RD-1014) and neither RD-1015 nor RD-1016 appears; with "Show archived" checked, both appear with an "Archived" badge. RD-1015's final state: title `scoarse1 RD Bench Ticket`, status Ready, Archived badge present, no parts.
